text: Matt Skills Flow 是面向 DSH Web 的工程工作流插件，在侧边栏提供工作流面板，并注册 /matt-flow 命令。它把需求决策、规格、依赖工单、隔离 Git Lane、审查与人工验收组织在一个可恢复的 Flow 中；用户可通过界面或命令查看、推进和恢复流程，也可导出证据。适合希望在 DSH 中按阶段规划并执行软件开发任务的团队。默认将工单图写入本地仓库；可选配置 GitHub Issues 跟踪器，需已有 gh 登录。

Matt Skills Flow adds a sidebar panel and /matt-flow command to DSH Web. It tracks decisions, specs, dependent tickets, Git work lanes, reviews, and acceptance in a recoverable workflow. Users can advance and resume work and export evidence. Optional GitHub Issues tracking needs gh authentication.
想在 DSH 里把软件需求拆成规格、依赖工单和可追踪的开发阶段。
需要用隔离的 Git worktree 并行处理开发任务，并在完成后逐步审查和验收。
I want to resume a staged coding workflow after a Harness restart and keep its decisions and task progress.
Matt Skills Flow 的功能「分阶段开发 Flow」：在侧边栏创建并查看关联仓库的工作流，记录决策、生成规格、维护依赖工单，并按阶段推进。用户通过面板中的表单和操作按钮管理流程。
Matt Skills Flow 的功能「工单 Lane 与验收」：为工单准备隔离 Lane，预览并启动可执行任务，之后集成完成的 Lane、请求审查并准备人工验收。相关操作在 Flow 面板中触发。
Matt Skills Flow 使用 GitHub 跟踪器时，会将工单标题和内容发送到 GitHub Issues；此模式需配置仓库并通过 gh 登录。

@deepseek-ai/dsh-matt-skills-flow README · dsh-matt-skills-flow：Matt Skills is an unofficial DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns [mattpocock/skills](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills) into a durable engineering workflow.

It keeps the current phase, installed Skill snapshot, Decisions, Specs, Ticket dependencies, isolated Git Lanes, review findings, human acceptance, evidence, and restart recovery in one Flow. The Web UI and `/matt-flow` commands use the same Host service, so a Flow can move between them without losing state.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-matt-skills-flow README · Features：- Snapshot the installed Matt Skills and their content digests at Flow creation.
- Preserve the initial goal or Bug context in the Flow and visualize review admission as an interactive lifecycle graph with a concise configuration summary.
- Record and supersede Decisions before generating and approving a Spec.
- Publish a dependency-aware Ticket Graph and preview its executable Frontier.
- Publish the graph to repository-local Markdown by default, or to GitHub Issues when the Host config selects `trackerKind: github` and an authenticated `gh` CLI is available.
- Create isolated Lane branches and worktrees from a Flow-owned integration branch.
- Run bounded Lane Agents, route blocked Questions back to the root session, and retry with a new packet digest.
- Integrate completed Lanes sequentially, run two-axis Standards/Spec review, and require human acceptance.
- Export redacted evidence and recover interrupted work after a Harness restart.
- Localized Simplified Chinese and English Web UI.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-matt-skills-flow README · Installation：Install a packed release with the official DeepSeek Harness plugin command:

```sh
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add --workspace-root ./deepseek-ai-dsh-matt-skills-flow-0.2.0.tgz
```

Start Harness Web normally:

```sh
pnpm dsh web
```

The plugin is designed for a DSH Web profile with `@deepseek-ai/dsh-commands`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill`, Git, and the standard Agent/Subagent services available.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-matt-skills-flow README · Usage：Open **Matt Skills** in the sidebar to create or select a Flow. A Flow is bound to an existing DSH Workspace and clean Git repository. Follow the visible Gates to record Decisions, approve the Spec, add and publish Tickets, prepare and run Lanes, integrate results, review the frozen candidate, and accept it as a human.

The same lifecycle is available from an active session:

@deepseek-ai/dsh-matt-skills-flow README · Usage：```text
/matt-flow start "Add account recovery"
/matt-flow list
/matt-flow status "Add account recovery"
/matt-flow continue <flow-id>

`/matt-flow continue` performs at most one unambiguous phase transition. Ambiguous planning, review, and acceptance decisions remain explicit UI actions.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-matt-skills-flow README · Usage：Ticket Graph publication is local by default. A Host configuration may set `trackerKind: github` and `githubRepository: owner/name`; publication verifies `gh` authentication and creates Issues in dependency order. The plugin never performs other GitHub mutations.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-matt-skills-flow README · Safety：The plugin never pushes, creates pull requests, merges the default branch, or deletes dirty worktrees. Candidate acceptance is human-only and rechecks the frozen candidate commit, review findings, Questions, and Flow revision before writing an Acceptance Receipt.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-matt-skills-flow README · Development：```sh
pnpm install
pnpm typecheck
pnpm test
pnpm build

Release artifacts contain the runtime, tests, package metadata, and public documentation needed to build and use the plugin.
